title: LivSafe: Deep Learning-based Liver Fibrosis Grading System with LLM-based Conversational Support
description: LivSafe is an application for doctors and hospitals aiding in automatic grading of liver fibrosis using patients' liver ultrasound scans. It features LivNet trained via LivSCP, and a low-rank adapted Meditron 7B with NedRAG and llama.cpp.
